probe: Public social API contracts ECDEV's social acquisition relies on
evidence_state: API_CONTRACT_PROBE through the session egress proxy; not an ECDEV runtime capture, not LIVE evidence, nothing stored as observations
why_not_ecdev_runtime: ECDEV's fetcher pins the public IPs it resolves and bypasses proxies (SSRF protection); this sandbox only allows egress through its proxy, so the runtime cannot reach these hosts here. The runtime paths remain fixture-proven.
findings: Hacker News (Algolia): page/nbPages chain without overlap, newest first; paging is capped at nbPages 20 x 50 = 1000 hits while nbHits reported 318608, so page walking alone can never reach a busy query's population.
Hacker News: nbHits is approximate (it moved 318608 -> 311531 between two consecutive requests; exhaustive.nbHits false) and must never serve as a coverage denominator.
Hacker News: numericFilters created_at_i bounds are honoured (a 24 h slice returned 72 hits on 2 pages, all inside the bounds), so date slicing keeps each slice under the 1000-hit cap.
Hacker News: items/{id} returns the whole reply tree in one response (126 nodes for num_comments 125, depth 11, parent_id on every reply, author on every node).

Bluesky: api.bsky.app searchPosts answers the first page unauthenticated but refuses the cursor of the next page with 403 'Request forbidden by administrative rules' (openresty), with no proxy relay failure recorded; public.api.bsky.app refuses search outright. Unauthenticated cursor walking stops after one page.
Bluesky: since/until bounds are honoured (25 posts, all inside a 24 h window), so time slices, not cursors, are the legitimate way to reach further back; hitsTotal 10000 is a cap, not a count.
Bluesky: app.bsky.feed.getPostThread on public.api.bsky.app returns reply trees (threadViewPost nodes; notFoundPost and blockedPost are typed node states).
JSON Feed (jsonfeed.org): version 1, no next_url; pagination ends after one page.
consequences: Bluesky cursor pages beyond the first are reported as a source refusal, not a network failure, and earlier pages are kept
date-sliced acquisition for Hacker News and Bluesky
reply trees from HN items/{id} and Bluesky getPostThread
source-reported totals carried as APPROXIMATE or CAPPED, never as denominators
